title: Network Security & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company:**
Provitious Technologies Private Limited
  
**Experience:**
3–5 Years
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
**Department:**
Cloud Infrastructure & Managed IT Services
  
**Primary Technology:**
Fortinet FortiGate
  
**Preferred Cloud Platforms:**
AWS and Microsoft Azure
  
**About the Role**
:
  
Provitius Technologies is looking for a skilled Network Security & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with hands-on experience in Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, network security, infrastructure administration, and cloud environments.
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing network security infrastructure, configuring and maintaining FortiGate firewalls, monitoring network performance, troubleshooting connectivity issues, and implementing security policies.
  
Candidates with additional experience in AWS, Microsoft Azure, cloud networking, and DevOps practices will be highly preferred.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
**Network Security & FortiGate Administration**

* Configure, manage, and maintain Fortinet FortiGate firewalls.
* Implement firewall policies, security rules, NAT, routing, and access control.
* Configure and manage IPsec and SSL VPN connections.
* Monitor firewall logs, security events, and network traffic.
* Troubleshoot firewall-related connectivity and security issues.
* Manage firmware upgrades, configuration backups, and firewall maintenance.
* Implement security best practices and network segmentation.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network activities.

**Network Administration**

* Manage LAN, WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, and network connectivity.
* Troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN, and routing issues.
* Monitor network availability, performance, and bandwidth utilization.
* Handle network incidents and provide timely resolution.
* Maintain network documentation, diagrams, and configuration records.

**Cloud Infrastructure – AWS & Azure (Preferred)**

* Manage and support cloud infrastructure across AWS and Microsoft Azure.
* Configure and manage cloud networking components.
* Work with AWS VPC, Subnets, Security Groups, Network ACLs, Route Tables, and VPN connectivity.
* Work with Azure Virtual Networks, NSGs, VPN Gateway, and Network Security configurations.
* Implement secure connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and cloud environments.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, availability, and security.
* Support cloud infrastructure deployment and troubleshooting.

**DevOps & Infrastructure Automation (Preferred)**

* Support infrastructure provisioning and configuration automation.
* Work with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
* Understand CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.
* Experience with Git, scripting, and infrastructure automation.
* Basic knowledge of Linux and Windows Server administration.
* Support containerized infrastructure using Docker where required.

**Monitoring, Documentation & Support**

* Monitor network and infrastructure health.
* Investigate and resolve infrastructure and security incidents.
* Maintain incident reports, troubleshooting records, and change logs.
* Coordinate with internal teams and customers for infrastructure support.
* Follow change management, incident management, and security procedures.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* 3–5 years of experience in Network Administration, Network Security, or Infrastructure Engineering
* .Hands-on experience with Fortinet FortiGate firewalls
* .Strong understanding of firewall policies, NAT, routing, VPN, and network security
* .Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, LAN and WAN
* .Experience in troubleshooting network connectivity and security incidents
* .Knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration
* .Good communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills

.
  
  
Preferred Skills:

* AWS infrastructure and networking experience
* .Microsoft Azure infrastructure and networking experience
* .AWS VPC, Security Groups, VPN and routing
* .Azure VNet, NSG, VPN Gateway and connectivity
* .Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
* .CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* .Python, Bash, or PowerShell scripting
* .Docker and container infrastructure
* .Fortinet NSE / FCP certifications or equivalent Fortinet certifications
* .AWS Solutions Architect or Azure Administrator certifications

.

title: IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company description**

TradeAir (IFSC) is an IFSCA-registered broker-dealer and fund management entity in GIFT City, trading on NSE IX and India INX.

**Role description**

You will build and run our trading infrastructure and mid- and back-office systems, and act as our CISO. We want someone who understands networks, systems and financial markets, and can show what they have built.

• Build and run trading infrastructure, including exchange connectivity to NSE IX and India INX.

• Set up access to international exchanges and brokers, such as CME via its Aurora data centre.

• Run data-centre and colocation environments, and design the network and server room for our new GIFT City office.

• Manage firewalls, VPN, leased lines, access control (with MFA) and separation between fund and broking teams.

• Support back-office, risk, reconciliation, email, user accounts and backups.

• Manage telecom, exchange, colocation and hardware vendors.

• Keep network diagrams, the asset inventory and DR drills current.

• As CISO, own the cybersecurity policy, VAPT and audits, incident response, regulatory reporting, and Board reporting on cyber risk.

**Qualifications**

• At least 3 years of hands-on network, systems or infrastructure work.

• Hands-on experience with routing and switching, firewalls, and Linux and Windows servers.

• Working knowledge of MFA, patching, logging, backups and incident response.

• Interest in financial markets and a basic understanding of order and market-data flow.

• Projects you can demonstrate.

• Able to work on site in GIFT City, Gandhinagar.

Good to have: experience at a broker, exchange member, prop firm, bank or fund; exposure to CME, SGX or FIX connectivity, market-data feeds or colocation; VAPT, cyber audits or regulatory cybersecurity frameworks; Python or Bash scripting; CCNA/CCNP, Fortinet NSE, Linux, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or ISO 27001.

How to apply: please apply through our careers page at tradeair.in/careers/it-infrastructure-engineer. Applications are reviewed only through the careers page.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Experience - 2-4 yrs experience as a DevOps Engineer or a related role
  
  
Location : GIFT CITY, Gandhinagar
  
  
Qualification : Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology
  
  
Shift : 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM
  
  
**Requirements**
We are searching for a skilled and experienced DevOps Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between development and operations, ensuring a smooth and efficient software delivery lifecycle. You will be responsible for automating processes, building and maintaining infrastructure, and collaborating with developers to deploy code changes seamlessly.
  
  

* Proven experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, etc.).
* Solid understanding of infrastructure as code (IaC) principles.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with configuration management tools (Chef, Puppet, Ansible).
* Strong scripting skills (Bash, Python, etc.).
* Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) (must).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate software delivery processes.
* Utilize infrastructure as code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Ansible to provision and manage infrastructure.
* Configure and manage cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Implement and maintain configuration management tools (Chef, Puppet, Ansible).
* Automate infrastructure deployments and configurations.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues.
* Collaborate with developers and operations teams to ensure smooth deployments.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest DevOps tools and technologies.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Relevant certifications from AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes Administrator, or similar.
* Agile Methodologies: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Networking: Understanding of networking concepts and technologies.
* Database Management: Experience with database management and optimization.
